ABOUT
Our Commitment to Excellence

LabraDon Properties is a veteran-owned and operated real estate company based in Hampton Roads, Virginia specializing in long-term rental properties, property renovations, and residential or commercial clean, repair, and renovate turnover services.

Our work is guided by military-driven values—integrity, discipline and attention to detail. Founded by Seth French, we take a hands-on approach for every project, however large or small it may be from renovation to final clean so that your property is rent-ready. For homeowners, our promise is to serve you with quality and respectful care of anything needed to rent or sell, assisting you or your realtor to gain top value for your investment.

Property managers and real estate investors often need our services, whether they need detail-oriented unit turnover, professional cleaning, or those last minute eye sores or repair targets to fulfill walk through needs for closing, LabraDon Properties will give you consistent, dependable results.

Our mission is to deliver reliable, high-quality real estate and unit turnover solutions in Hampton Roads, Virginia and Virginia Peninsula, assisting in smart investments, efficient renovations, and dependable service.

We are committed to:

🏠 Developing and supporting long-term rental properties in Hampton Roads

🛠️ Delivering LabraDon Unit Turnover Services, including rent-ready preparation and cleaning

🤝 Supporting Hampton Roads property managers, real estate investors, and owners

At LabraDon Properties, we don’t just work on properties — we create lasting value, operational consistency, and peace of mind for the people who rely on us 🇺🇸🏗️.

Why LabraDon Properties?
While transitioning out of the United States Marine Corps as a Joint Terminal Attack Controller (JTAC 8002), I started thinking about how I could use my passion for helping people to gain what they wanted from their investments, typically homes,
businesses or other properties to sustain the lifestyles important to them.

Born and raised in Evansville, Indiana, a small town with southern like values and having family connections in Hampton Roads, I knew that my participation in growing communities would be my next career path. That is, in addition to caring for my Labrador Don and my family.

Bingo! The name of my business had to be LabraDon Properties.


Seth French and Donnie, Founder of LabraDon Properties,
brings a strong foundation in strategic communication, business leadership, and
operations to every project.

Seth holds a Master of Business Administration and Master of Arts in Strategic Communication from Regent University, where he developed expertise in leadership, messaging, and organizational strategy, further strengthening his capabilities in business operations, finance, and scalable growth 📈.

He also earned a Bachelor of Arts in Communication Studies, with a concentration in Public Relations and Advertising, providing a strong background in branding, client relations, and stakeholder communication. In addition, Seth completed an Associate of Science through the ASAP program at Ivy Tech Community College in Evansville, Indiana 🎓.

This blend of education, military service, and hands-on real estate experience allows
LabraDon Properties to operate with both
strategic insight and disciplined execution 💪.

UNIT TURNOVER SERVICES
Rent-Ready Units. Done Right. On Schedule.

LabraDon Properties provides full-service unit turnover solutions designed for apartment communities and residential portfolios that demand speed, consistency, and accountability.

Our process ensures units are move-in ready, reducing vacancy time and eliminating the need for multiple vendors or follow-up work.

What’s Included in a Standard Unit Turnover

Each turnover is completed using a repeatable, checklist-driven process to ensure consistency across every unit.

Interior Cleaning & Prep

• Full kitchen cleaning (appliances, cabinets, counters, sinks)

• Bathroom sanitation and detailing

• Interior surface cleaning (baseboards, doors, trim)

• Floor cleaning and detailing

• Trash removal (normal turnover debris)

• Visual quality check prior to completion

• Unit left in rent-ready condition

• Ready for inspection and leasing

Be sure to check our add-on services for Special Condition Cleanup.

Final Presentation

We want you to have a positive experience with the outcomes of choosing LabraDon
Properties. You can expect to walk into a finished unit knowing that we value your
business and your property. We always want to do know anything we have missed in
your expectations so that we can respond immediately!

Our Goal: Property managers won’t have to touch it again!

Turnaround Time & Reliability

A few more good reasons to hire LabraDon Properties…
• Our standard scheduling system provides predictable timelines.
• We offer expedited service when needed.
• Clear communications from start to finish is critical throughout our projects.
• You do not have to worry about subcontractor roulette! All work is controlled and held accountable internally.
• We understand that vacancy days COST MONEY, so our systems are built to minimize downtime.

And…we honor our customers with a transparent pricing structure.

Multi-unit services are handled with consistent quality across units. We treat unit turnovers as part of your asset’s performance, not just as a cleaning task.

Locally Owned with Local Accountability!

Request Unit Turnover Service

If you’re looking for a reliable turnover partner that understands operations—not just cleaning—let’s talk!

Rent-Ready. Guaranteed.

SPECIAL CONDITION CLEANUP

Additional services are often needed during renovations, move-outs, emergencies, or seasonal cleanups such as storm debris and snow removal. Some units require more than a standard turnover, especially when dealing with pet hair, strong odors, or heavy wear and tear. That’s why we provide clearly defined, condition-based deep dive add-on services so there are no surprises.

• Excessive pet hair or dander removal

• Heavy soil or neglected units

• Odor and smell remediation

• Bodily fluid or bio-contamination cleanup

• Furniture or debris removal

• Emergency or expedited turnarounds

• Snow removal

All add-on services are documented and approved prior to execution when possible.
